caseName: White Stag Manufacturing Co. v. Ellis
caseNameFull: WHITE STAG MANUFACTURING CO. v. ELLIS, MEMBERS OF THE STATE TAX COMMISSION OF OREGON
attorneys: Walter H. Evans, Jr. for appellant., Robert Y. Thornton, Attorney General of Oregon, and Carlisle B. Roberts and Gerald F. Bartz, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
